name: OMR Reviews

sources.title: OMR homepage — media company; Reviews is the software/services comparison arm
OMR Reviews — 80,000+ verified reviews; 'Suggest software or service' and 'Information for software providers' links

requirements: B2B software products or agencies/service providers — the directory covers software categories (HR, CRM, SEO, AI, project management, etc.) plus agency/service categories
Entry path is the 'Suggest software or service' form on /en/reviews; providers have a dedicated 'Information for software providers' page
Review ecosystem is verified-review based (German-origin, English locale available at /en/)
preparation: Product/company name, website, best-fit software or service category
Company/provider details for the suggestion form
Longer-term: a review-generation plan — rankings/badges (Leader, Top Rated, Top 100) are driven by verified review volume
workflow: Open https://omr.com/en/reviews and click 'Suggest software or service' (providers: 'Information for software providers')
Await OMR review team's acceptance and profile creation
Once listed, drive verified user reviews to qualify for category rankings/badges
watchFor: This is not a self-serve launch board — the 'suggest' route means OMR editorially controls whether a profile is created
Site is primarily German; use /en/ locale links
Ranking badges are earned via verified reviews — a bare listing has near-zero visibility without them
Provider pricing/monetisation terms were not visible on the public pages fetched
countsAsLive: A product profile exists under OMR Reviews with a review count and 'See reviews' link, reachable from its category page
unknowns: Whether provider listings are free or paid ('Information for software providers' content not fetched)
Form fields on the suggest-software flow
Acceptance criteria and timeline for suggested products
